  intro p q hpq h
  have h2 := e.injective h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h2
  obtain ⟨h1, h3⟩ := h2
  have key : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a - b| ≤ 1 → (((⌊2*a⌋:ℤ):ZMod 3) = ((⌊2*b⌋:ℤ):ZMod 3)) → |a-b| < 1/2 := by

      have : ((⌊2*b⌋ - ⌊2*a⌋ : ℤ):ℝ) = ((3 * k : ℤ):ℝ) := by rw [hk]; simp
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    have a1 := Int.floor_le (2*a)
    have a2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (2*a)
    have b1 := Int.floor_le (2*b)
    have b2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (2*b)
    have hab' := abs_le.mp hab
    have k1 : (k:ℝ) < 1 := by linarith [hab'.1, hab'.2]
    have k2 : (-1:ℝ) < (k:ℝ) := by linarith [hab'.1, hab'.2]

    have k4 : -1 < k := by exact_mod_cast k2

    subst k0
    simp at hk'

    constructor <;> linarith [hab'.1, hab'.2]

    have := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (p - q)
    rw [hpq] at this
    simpa using this

    have := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (p - q)
    rw [hpq] at this
    simpa using this

  have y1 := key _ _ him h3
  have hn : (p.re - q.re)^2 + (p.im - q.im)^2 = 1 := by

    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at this

theorem probe_nv : ∃ coloring : ℂ → Fin 9, OAI.EuclideanFiveColor.ProperColoring 9 coloring := by
  classical
  let e : ZMod 3 × ZMod 3 ≃ Fin 9 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (by simp [ZMod.card])
  refine ⟨fun z => e (((⌊2*z.re⌋ : ℤ) : ZMod 3), ((⌊2*z.im⌋ : ℤ) : ZMod 3)), ?_⟩
  intro p q hpq h
  have h2 := e.injective h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h2
  obtain ⟨h1, h3⟩ := h2
  have key : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a - b| ≤ 1 → (((⌊2*a⌋:ℤ):ZMod 3) = ((⌊2*b⌋:ℤ):ZMod 3)) → |a-b| < 1/2 := by
    intro a b hab h
    rw [ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub] at h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
    have hk' : ((⌊2*b⌋:ℤ):ℝ) - ((⌊2*a⌋:ℤ):ℝ) = 3 * (k:ℝ) := by
      have : ((⌊2*b⌋ - ⌊2*a⌋ : ℤ):ℝ) = ((3 * k : ℤ):ℝ) := by rw [hk]; simp
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    have a1 := Int.floor_le (2*a)
    have a2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (2*a)
    have b1 := Int.floor_le (2*b)
    have b2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (2*b)
    have hab' := abs_le.mp hab
    have k1 : (k:ℝ) < 1 := by linarith [hab'.1, hab'.2]
    have k2 : (-1:ℝ) < (k:ℝ) := by linarith [hab'.1, hab'.2]
    have k3 : k < 1 := by exact_mod_cast k1
    have k4 : -1 < k := by exact_mod_cast k2
    have k0 : k = 0 := by omega
    subst k0
    simp at hk'
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [hab'.1, hab'.2]
  have hre : |p.re - q.re| ≤ 1 := by
    have := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (p - q)
    rw [hpq] at this
    simpa using this
  have him : |p.im - q.im| ≤ 1 := by
    have := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (p - q)
    rw [hpq] at this
    simpa using this
  have x1 := key _ _ hre h1
  have y1 := key _ _ him h3
  have hn : (p.re - q.re)^2 + (p.im - q.im)^2 = 1 := by
    have := Complex.sq_norm (p - q)
    rw [hpq, Complex.normSq_apply] at this
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at this
    nlinarith
  rw [abs_lt] at x1 y1
  nlinarith [x1.1, x1.2, y1.1, y1.2]
